correctness.rationale: For each open ladder L_n=P_n square K2, n>=2, proper ternary colourings are parametrized by a free initial colour a_1 and rung differences d_i=+-1, with horizontal transitions u_i and u_i+d_(i+1)-d_i both nonzero. Global colour translation kills all characters with nonzero total gamma frequency. For balanced characters the exact Fourier sum is 3 * 1^T D_delta1 T_s1 ... T_s(n-1) D_deltan 1. T0=[[2,1],[1,2]], each T_s for s=1,2 is rank one with entries [-1,omega^s;omega^-s,-1]. Rank-one factorization and the lambda=1-omega-adic endpoint lemma show interior factors never zero, while endpoint zeros obey the stated first/last nonzero cumulative s_j conditions. For s all zero, the only zeros are delta strings with one equal nonzero adjacent pair. Counting independent endpoint constraints yields (3*9^n-24n+45)/16 nonzero characters and extra balanced nullity (7*9^n+72n-135)/48. Independent full Fourier enumeration for n=2,3,4 found ranks 15,135,1227 of 27,243,2187 balanced characters. Finite checks corroborate; proof covers every n>=2.
residual_risks: Full proof depends on a valuation argument at lambda=1-omega for all endpoint strings; independent direct checks cover only n<=4, and package routines reach n<=7.
